strings.seo.faq[0].q: Xana pdff i ya mahala hakunene?
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Ina. Xitirhiso xin'wana na xin'wana i xa mahala, ku nga ri na xiyimiso naswona ku hava leswi pfarisiwaka endka xichulu. A ku na khadi ra nkoloto leri vutisiwaka.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: E-e. Ku nga ri na ku tsarisa, ku nga ri na adirese ya imeyili: u tirhisa switirhiso hi ku hatlisa.
strings.seo.faq[2].q: Xana swilebyi swa wena swi hlayisiwile?
strings.seo.faq[2].a: E-e. Tifayili ta wena ti tirhiseriwa ntsena ntirho lowu u wu kombeleke, kutani ti hlanguriwa. Ku hava loyi a ti hlamuselaka naswona a ti rhumelaniwi.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Ina. pdff yi tirha eka xibiyele xa foni, tebulati kumbe khompyuta (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), ku nga ri na nchumu wo nghenisa.
strings.seo.faq[4].q: Xana i swibumbeko swihi leswi seketelwaka?
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, swifaniso (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC (iPhone), TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML na swin’wana.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: U nga tirhisa ku ya fika eka {files} swiyenge hi nkarhi wun’we, nasona dokumente leyi humesiwaka yi nga va ni ku ya fika eka {pages} matluka.
strings.privacy.title: Vutihami
strings.privacy.description: Ndlela leyi pdff yi khomaka tifayili ta wena: ku nga ri na akhawunti, ku nga ri na xilebyi lexi hlayisiwaka, ku nga ri na switatisi na ku xavisiwa ka vuxokoxoko.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff yi vumbiwile leswaku swilebyi swa wena swi tshama swi ri swa wena. Laha ku ri, hi marito ya ntolovelo, leswi humelelaka loko u yi tirhisa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Tifayili ta wena
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ti rhumeriwa ti sirheleriwile (HTTPS), ti endliwa hi vutshila, kutani ti hlanguriwa hi ku hatlisa loko vumundzuku byi lulamile. Tifayili letikulu ti hundza eka vuhlayisi bya nkarhinyana hansi ka vito ro hlawuriwa naswona ti hlanguriwa hi ku hatlisa loko ntirho wu helile; ku basisa ka vutshila ku susa xin'wana na xin'wana lexi nga sala eka tiawara ta 24 hi ku hatlisa.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Ku nga ri na akhawunti, ku nga ri na vuxokoxoko bya munhu hi xiyexe
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff yi nga kumbi ku tsarisa, adirese ya imeyili na khadi ra nkoloto. Swilebyi swa wena a swi hlayisiwi, a swi kambisisiwi, a swi hlanganyelaniwi kumbe ku tirhiseriwa ku letela vutshila bya mianakano.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Ku pima vaendzi
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Hi hlayerisa vaendzi ku nga ri na vito naswona ku nga ri na ti-cookie (Vercel Web Analytics) ku dyondza leswaku i switirhiso swihi leswi pfunaka. Ku nga ri na switatisi, ku nga ri na ku landzelelana ka tiwebusayiti.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Ti-cookie
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Cookie yin'we leyi hlawuriwaka: yi tsundzuka ririmi leri u ri hlawurile.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Vuhlayisi bya webusayiti
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Webusayiti yi khomiwa hi Vercel eka meseletara eParis; ku hundzula ka Word, Excel na PowerPoint ku khomiwa hi Render eFrankfurt. Vapfumeri lava va khoma tifayili ntsena nkarhi wa ku hundzula.

strings.legal.terms.sections[0].title: I mani loyi a humesaka pdff
strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: pdff yi endliwe, yiakiwile nasona yi humesiwile hi Mikailou Cedric Toure, un’wana loyi a akile eNew Brunswick, Canada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Layisense ya mahala yo tirhisa, eka un’wana ni un’wana
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: pdff i mahala, handle ko tsarisa na ku nga ri na nkarhi lowu yaka eku heleni, eka un’wana ni un’wana: vanhu, vaadyondzi, vadyondzisi, mabindzu, mintlawa leyi nga riki ya bindzu, mimfumo ya tiko, eCanada na matiko man’wana. A ku na nchumu lexi vekeriwelke ntsena lava hakelaka, hikuva a xi kona. Tifayili leti u ti humesaka i ta wena ntsena: a ti na swifaniso swa xihundla kumbe ku boxa pdff.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Tifayili ta wena hinkwato, hikuva ti xihundla
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: U nga tirhisa nchumu wun’wana ni wun’wana wa dokumente, ku katsa na leti nga ni xihundla, hikuva pdff a yi hlayi, yi kambisisa, yi hlayisa kumbe ku hlanganisa tifayili ta wena: ti tirhisiwa hi ku tiyendla kutani ti hlakulwa. U sala u ri n’wini wa tona, nasona u fanelile kuva ni mfanelo yo ti tirhisa.
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Khowudi na ku nghenisa eka ti server ta wena
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Khowudi ya pdff yi humesiwile ehansi ka layisense ya MIT. U nga yi hlayi, yi kambisisa, yi nghenisa eka ti server ta wena (ku katsa na laha ku nga riki na inthanete), yi cinca na ku yi Rhumela mahala, ntsena u hlayisa vito ra loyi a yi endleke na rito ra layisense.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Ku tirhisa loku pfumeleriwaka
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: A wu fanelanga ku tirhisa pdff eka mintirho yo biha, ku ringeta ku onha ntiyiso (ku rhumela hi ku hatlisa swinene, ku nghena hi xihundla) kumbe ku tlula milawu ya yona. Vukulu na ntsengo wa tifayili swi sirhela sayiti leyi eka un’wana ni un’wana.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Ku kumeka ka yona
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: pdff yi nyikiwa mahala. Yi nga cinca, yi yimisiwa hikwalaho ka ku lunghisa kumbe ku helisiwa. Tshama u ri ni tifayili ta wena to sungula: pdff a yi hlayisi khopi ya tona.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Xitiyiso na vutihlamuleri
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Xitirho lexi xi nyikiwa “tano hi ku va ka xona”, handle ka xitiyiso xa muxaka wun’wana ni un’wana. Hi ku ya hi nawu, loyi a yi endleke a ri na vutihlamuleri bya ku lahlekeriwa hi data kumbe ku cinca loku nga hetisekangiki. Kamba dokumente leyi u yi humesaka u nga yi sebenzisanga eka nchumu wun’wana ni wun’wana wa nkoka.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Mfanelo ya mianakanyo
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Vito ra pdff, xifaniso xa yona na marito ya sayiti i ya loyi a yi endleke; khowudi yi ehansi ka layisense ya MIT tanihi leswi boxiwaka laha henhla. Mavito yaswibumabumelo lama boxiwaka (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) i ya vayini va tona.

strings.legal.terms.sections[8].text: Milawu leyi yi lawuriwa hi milawu ya Xifundzankulu xa New Brunswick na milawu ya tiko ra Canada. Tiko ra New Brunswick ri na mfanelo, handle ko sivela mfanelo leyi nawu wa tiko ra ka wena wu ku nyikaka yona tanihi xirho xa vaaki.

strings.legal.security.title: Vuhlayiseki na data
strings.legal.security.description: Lesi a xi humelelaka eka swifaki swa wena eka pdff: ku tirhisa hi yexe, ku hava ku kambisisa, ku suriwa hi nkarhi wolowo, ku sirhelela hi xihundla, ku hlayisa eEurope, ni ku hlawula ku yi nghenisa eka ti-server ta wena.
strings.legal.security.intro: Lesi a xi humelelaka eka swifaki swa wena, laha ti tirhisiwaka kona ni ndlela leyi ti sirheleliwaka ha yona: ku hlamuseriwile hi ku olova, eka vanhu hinkwavo ni mintlawa ya IT.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: A ku na tifayili leti hlayisiwaka
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Swifaki swa wena swi tirhisiwa hi yexe, kutani swi suriwa hi nkarhi lowu vuyelo byi nga lunghela kumbe byi khophuliwile. Ku hava khophu, ku hava ku hlayisa ni ku hava matimu. Ku hlaya ka siku na siku ka ku basisa hi yexe ku dzwihata ni xifaki xihi na xihi xa nkarhanyana lexi nga salaka, hi siku leri landzelaka eku heteleleni.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: A ku na ku kambisisa
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Ku hava loyi a hlayaka matsalwa ya wena. A ma katsiwi, a ma kambisisiwi, a ma avelaniwi kumbe ku tirhisiwa ku dyondzisa vutlhari bya makete. pdff yi hava ti-akawunti, ti-ad ni matsalwa ya vatirhisi.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Ku rhulela ka xihundla
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Ku hlanganisa ko karhi ka sirheleriwile (HTTPS) nasona sayiti yi sindzisa ku sirhelela eka ku endzela ko kala ku nga heli (HSTS). Xitirhisiwa xo Sirhelela xi sirhelela ti-PDF ta wena hi AES-256; rito ra xihundla leri u ri hlawulaka a ri hlayisiwi.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Laha tifayili ta wena ti tirhisiwaka kona
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Sayiti, PDF ni switirhisiwa swa swifaniso: Vercel, Paris data center (France, European Union). Word, Excel ni PowerPoint ti-conversion: Render, e Frankfurt (Germany, European Union). Swifaki leswi hundzaka 4 MB: temporary Vercel Blob storage, ehansi ka vito ra xihundla, ri suririle endzhaku ka ku tirhisiwa.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Vuhlayiseki bya xithekiniki
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Swihlokwana swa vusirheleli (HSTS, ku sivela sayiti leswaku yi nga nghenisiwi eka matsalwa man’wana, ku sirhelela eka ku hlawula ka mixaka ya swifaki), ti-address ta swifaki swa nkarhanyana leti ti nga kotiki ku pfuxetiwa, ni vutirheli bya ku hundzula lebyi amukelaka ntsena swikombelo leswi rhwalaka xitifiketi xa xihundla. Ku cinca ka khodi xin’wana ni xin’wana ku kambisisiwa hi yexe (ku kambela, ku kambela mixaka) emahlweni ka ku ya eka vutomi.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Vuhundzu bya xihundla na nawu lowu tirhaka
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdff yi kandziyisiwile e New Brunswick nasona yi landzela nawu wa Canada wa Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA). A yi hlengeleti vuxokoxoko bya munhu hi xiyexe hi vatirhisi va yona: ku hava akawunti, ku hava adirese ya imeyili, ku hava cookie ya ku landzelela. Yiakiwile eka milawu leyi fanaka na ya European GDPR ni ya Quebec Law 25: ku hunguta vuxokoxoko, ku nga ha tirhisiwi nakambe, ku suriwa endzhaku ka ku tirhisiwa.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Eka mintlawa leyi nga ni milawu yo tiyisa
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Loko milawu ya wena yi sivela ku rhumela matsalwa eka vutirheli byahandle, nghenisa pdff eka ti-server ta wena. Software leyiheleleke yi mahala, i open source nasona yi tirha ku nga ri na Internet: a ku na xifaki lexi sukaka eka nseketelo wa wena. Xiletelo xa ku nghenisa xi le ka pajina ra nseketelo.
strings.legal.security.sections[7].title: Ku vonikela
strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Khodi leyi heleleke ya xihlovo i ya mani na mani: mintlawa ya wena ya vusirheleli yi nga kambela marito lawa hinkwawo.

strings.legal.accessibility.description: pdff accessibility statement: WCAG 2.2 level AA target, measures in place, known limitations and how to report a barrier.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Munhu un’wana ni un’wana u fanele ku kota ku tirhisiisa pdff, ku katsa ni vanhu lava nga voniki kumbe lava vonaka hi xiyimo xa hansi, lava nga twiki kumbe lava twaka hi xiyimo xa hansi, kumbe lava nga ni vuvabyi bya ku famba-famba kumbe bya mianakanyo.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Xipikara xa xiyimo
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdff yi lava ku fambelana na Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, level AA, nsinya wa matiko ya misava wa W3C. Xiyimo lexi xi khumbi swilaveko swa Standard on Web Accessibility ya Government of Canada, European standard EN 301 549 ni Section 508 eka United States, leti kongomaka eka WCAG 2.0 kumbe 2.1 level AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Xiyimo xa ku yingiserana
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdff yi fambelana hi xiyimo xa hansi na WCAG 2.2 level AA: swihoxo leswi tiviwaka swi tsariwile ehansi. Xitatimende lexi xi seketelwe eka ku kambisisa ka ndzeni loku endliweke hi October 2, 2026, hi ku tirhisa switirhisiwa swa ku tirhisa hi yexe (axe, Lighthouse) ni ku kambisisa hi mavoko (keyboard, contrast, zoom, announcements). Ku hava ku kambisisa ko yimelela loku endliweke ku kondza ku fikela sweswi.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Leswi swi nga kona
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Sayiti hinkwayo yi tirha hi keyboard, hi xiyelanisi xa “Skip to content” ni xifaniso lexi vonakaka eka xiyenge lexi tirhaka. Ku hambana ka matsalwa i 4.5:1 kumbe ku tlula. Maganyiso ya ntirho (upload, result, error) ma tivisiwa eka va-screen reader. Xilandzwana xa swifaki xi nga cinciwa ku nga ri hi ku kokela ni ku veka, hi ku tirhisa swiboniso. Sayiti yi landzela xiyimo xa “reduce motion” xa xitirhisiwa xa wena: animations ti yima hi ku helela. Matsalwa ma hambana ku va ma hlayeka eka 4.0x zoom ni eka mobile. Ririmi ra pajina rin’wana ni rin’wana ri tivisiwile, nasona Arabic yi kombisiwa ku suka exineneni ku ya exineneni.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Ku kayivela loku tiviwaka
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Handle ka xiyimo xexo, animations ta ku rhwala (background, ring, format ticker) ti tirha minkama hinkwayo; ticker yi yima loko u veka khodi ehenhla ka yona kumbe u yi khumba hi keyboard. Xirhendzevuri lexi titshunxaka eka home page xi tirhisiwa hi mouse kumbe hi munwe; i xa ku rhwala, nasona nxaxamelo wa swiyimo leswi xi swi kombaka wu kumeka tanihi matsalwa eka pajina. Tilirimi leti hundzuluxiw സാധാരണ ti nga va ni swihoxo. Eku heteleleni, ku tikeka ka ku fikelela ka xifaki lexi endliweke ku titshege hi xihlovo: pdff a yi engeteli ti-tag ta ku fikelela eka PDF leyi nga riki na tona.

strings.tools.ocr.seoDescription: Hlaya matsalwa ya PDF leyi hlahluwaka kumbe xifaniso (OCR) leswaku u nga yi lava, u kopa kumbe u endla yi hlayiwa ehenhla. Tirimi ta 16, mahala, dokumenti a yi vikiwanga.
strings.tools.ocr.intro: Dokumenti leyi hlahluwaka kumbe xifaniso i xifaniso ntsongo: u nge kume rito kumbe u kopa xivulwa. Hlaya xi-scan yi tiva papila rin’wana ni rin’wana (leswi swi vuriwa OCR) kutani yi engetela matsalwa ya ntiyiso eka dokumenti handle ko cinca ndlela leyi yi vonakaka ha yona. Ku hlaya ku endleka eka xitirho xa wena: dokumenti ya wena a yi vikiwanga. I xiyimiso ntsongo xa ririmi leri hlawuriwaka (MB titsongo) lexi koka eka interneti kan’we.

strings.tools.remplir.guide.faq[0].q: Hikwalaho ka yini pdff yi nga kumi swiyenge swihi na swihi?

strings.tools.comparer.name: Ringanisa
strings.tools.comparer.tagline: Vonaka leswi cinceke exikarhi ka vuhundzuluxi byimbirhi bya PDF.
strings.tools.comparer.seoTitle: Ringanisa ti-PDF timbirhi eka intanete: vona ku hambana
strings.tools.comparer.seoDescription: Ringanisa vuhundzuluxi byimbirhi bya khontiraka kumbe dokumenti ya PDF: marito lama engeteriwaka hi rihlaza, marito lama susiwaka hi ku tsandza, ni xiviko lexi kokiwaka. Mahala, ku hava lexi vikiwaka.
strings.tools.comparer.intro: Pela vuhundzuluxi bya khale, kutani lebyintshwa: ku hambana ku vonaka hi nkarhi wolowo, hi rito hi rito. Tlanyaza Ringanisa leswaku u koka xiviko. Hinkwaswo swi endleka eka browser ya wena.
strings.tools.comparer.options.ignoreCase.label: Honisa matsalwa lamanene ni ya le hansi
strings.tools.comparer.guide.keywords: ringanisa ti-pdf timbirhi, pdf diff, ringanisa vuhundzuluxi byimbirhi bya dokumenti, ringanisa tikontiraka, kuma ku cinca eka pdf
strings.tools.comparer.guide.uses[0]: Kambela leswi cinceke eka khontiraka kumbe mpfumelelo ungati sayina.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.uses[1]: Kambela ku lulamisiwa loku endliwaka eka xiviko kumbe xiyenge.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.uses[2]: Ringanisa vuhundzuluxi byimbirhi bya nawu kumbe matsalwa ya mfumo.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[0].title: Pela vuhundzuluxi bya khale
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[1].title: Hlaya ku hambana
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[1].text: Rihlaza ri kombisa leswi engeteriwaka, ku tsandza ka rihlaza ku kombisa leswi susiwaka.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[2].title: Tlanyaza Ringanisa
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[2].text: U koka xiviko xo hlayisa kumbe ku kandzisa.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[0].q: Xana madokumenti ya mina ya vikiwile?
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[0].a: E-e: ku ringanisa ku endleka hi ku helela eka browser ya wena.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[1].q: Xana ndzi nga ringanisa madokumenti lama hlahluwaka?
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[1].a: E-e,endzhaku ko hundzisa eka xitirho xo Hlaya xi-scan, lexi humesaka matsalwa ya wona.
strings.tools.images.name: Humesa swifaniso
strings.tools.images.tagline: Kuma ti-foto ni swifaniso ehandle ka PDF.
strings.tools.images.seoTitle: Humesa swifaniso eka PDF eka intanete mahala
strings.tools.images.seoDescription: Kuma foto yin’wana ni yin’wana, xifaniso ni logo eka PDF tanihi PNG kumbe JPG, handle ka ku phindha. Mahala, ku hava ku tsarisa, tifayili ti susiwa hi nkarhi wolowo.
strings.tools.images.intro: Pela PDF: pdff yi kuma xifaniso xin’wana ni xin’wana lexi nga eka yona kutani yi ku nyika xin’wana hi xin’wana, tanihi PNG kumbe JPG, eka fayili ya ZIP. Swifaniso switsongo swa ku saseka ni ku phindha swi siyiwa ehandle.
strings.tools.images.options.format.label: Fometi ya xifaniso
strings.tools.images.options.format.hints.png: Vukulu lebyi hetisekaka, byi hlayisa ku vonaka.
strings.tools.images.options.small.label: Tlhela u hlayisa swifaniso switsongo (ti-icon, timakrobhe)
strings.tools.images.guide.keywords: humesa swifaniso eka pdf, hlayisa swifaniso eka pdf, kuma ti-foto ehandle ka pdf, xihumesi xa swifaniso swa pdf
strings.tools.images.guide.uses[0]: Kuma ti-foto ehandle ka khathaloku ya PDF, xiviko kumbe broxure.
strings.tools.images.guide.uses[1]: Tirhisa logo nakambe kumbe xifaniso eka mbulavulo.
strings.tools.images.guide.uses[2]: Hlayisa swifaniso swa dokumenti ungati herisa.
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[0].title: Pela PDF ya wena
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[1].title: Hlawula PNG kumbe JPG
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[1].text: PNG ya vukulu lebyi hetisekaka, JPG ya tifayili titsongo.
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[2].title: Tlanyaza Humesa swifaniso
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[2].text: U kuma swifaniso hinkwaswo eka fayili ya ZIP.
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[0].q: Xana leswi swi hambana njhani ni ku hundzula PDF ku ya eka JPG?
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[0].a: Ku hundzula ku endla tluka rin’wana ni rin’wana ri va xifaniso. Ku humesa swifaniso ku kuma ti-foto ni swifaniso endzeni ka matluka ntsongo, hi vukulu bya tona bya khale.
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[1].q: Hikwalaho ka yini swifaniso swin’wana swi kayivela?
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[1].a: Swifaniso switsongo (ti-icon, timakrobhe) swi siyiwa ehandle hi xiyimiso: hlawula "Tlhela u hlayisa swifaniso switsongo". Matsalwa ni swifaniso swa vector a hi swifaniso, hi swona leswi swi nga humesiwaka.
strings.tools.redimensionner.name: Cinca vukulu / tsemula
strings.tools.redimensionner.tagline: Cinca vukulu bya xifaniso kumbe u xi tsemula.
strings.tools.redimensionner.seoTitle: Cinca vukulu ni ku tsemula swifaniso eka intanete mahala
strings.tools.redimensionner.seoDescription: Tsongo xifananiso (hi % kumbe eka ti-pixel) kumbe u xi tsemula eka square, 16:9 kumbe 4:3, kutani u xi hlayisa tanihi JPG, PNG kumbe WebP. Mahala, ku hava ku tsarisa.
strings.tools.redimensionner.intro: Pela swifaniso swa wena, hlawula ku swi hunguta kumbe ku swi tsemula, kambela leswi vonakaka, kutani u tlanyaza Cinca vukulu / tsemula. Swa pfuna eka xifaniso xa profile, xiyenge lexi nga ni ntiko wun’wana kumbe fomo leyi lavaka vukulu by karhi.
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.mode.label: U fanele ku endla yini?
Tsemula makumu leswaku u kuma fometi leyi hlayisekaka.
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.scale.label: Vukulu lebyintshwa
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.width.label: Kukoka (ti-pixel)
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.height.help: 0 = ku hlayiwa leswaku ku hlayisiwa vukulu.
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.ratio.label: Fometi
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.keywords: cinca vukulu bya xifaniso, hunguta vukulu bya foto, tsemula xifaniso eka intanete, cinca vukulu bya foto, endla xifaniso xi tsongo, xifaniso xa square
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.uses[0]: Hunguta foto leyi nga ni ntiko wun’wana eka email kumbe fomo ya intanete.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.uses[1]: Tsemula foto eka square ya profile.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.uses[2]: Lungiselela swifaniso swa 16:9 swa mbulavulo kumbe website.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.steps[1].text: Leswi vonakaka swi kombisa ndhawu leyi hlayisiwaka ni vukulu lebyintshwa.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[0].q: Xana foto yi lahlekeriwa hi vukulu?
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[0].a: Xifaniso lexi tsongo xi ni ti-pixel titsongo kambe xi tshama xi tsakile eka vukulu bya xona lebyintshwa.
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[1].q: Xana ku tsemula ku endleka kwihi?
strings.tools.redimensionner.guide.faq[1].a: Xikarhi ka xifaniso: makumu ma tsemiwa kahle ku fikelela fometi leyi hlawuriwaka, tanihi leswi leswi vonakaka swi kombisaka.
